text: Out in the desert, a caravan passed. They sent a man to draw water, and he let down his bucket...
They hid him away as merchandise. And they sold him for a cheap price... a few dirhams. To them, he was worth almost nothing.
The man in Egypt who bought him told his wife: "Make his stay comfortable. Perhaps we will adopt him as a son."
A boy thrown away by his own brothers... was now living in one of the great houses of Egypt.
And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.
Yusuf grew into a man, and Allah gave him judgment and knowledge.
But that same house was about to bring his hardest test.
